messages.author: 0eb5a09fd4de9e5e
messages.subject: Re: How to Setup local Package repository
parts:
Hi, Ankur


From your mail, I don't have sufficient information to answer the question, so here are some pointers:
  • The specific process of setting up a local repository is described in the manuals at https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-admin.html#Setting-up-a-package-repository.
  • You can easily create a full mirror of of CRAN: https://cran.r-project.org/mirror-howto.html
  • If you want to create local mirror that contains only some CRAN packages, then you can use miniCRAN (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/miniCRAN/index.html). See the vignette at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/miniCRAN/vignettes/miniCRAN-introduction.html
Regards

Andrie
